key_insight: For day-ahead solar PV forecasting, input feature selection mattered more than the choice among strong algorithms, with the best models achieving 11.6% nRMSE.
engineering_relevance: Reproducible evaluation, reference forecasts and calibrated uncertainty can make PV forecasts more trustworthy for operational planning.
method: Combine automated model search with explainable AI.
Compare forecasts against smart persistence and assess validation-split effects.
Calibrate prediction intervals and test SHAP attribution stability.
evidence_signal: On a full test year from a 16.32 kWp plant in Porto using 4 km weather forecasts, the best models roughly halved smart-persistence error; conformal calibration raised nominal 80% interval coverage from 64.5% to 81.7%.
watch_item: SHAP rankings shifted when correlated inputs were removed, so attributions describe model behavior rather than physical properties of the plant.
paper_title: Explainable AI for Solar PV Power Forecasting: From Model Selection to Trustworthy, Reproducible Deployment
